DamageMeter.name: 皮皮统计: Skada
DamageMeter.changelog: 适配 v0.113.0 商店与地图决策采集
changelog_detail: 兼容新版购买入口和商品列表返回类型，避免漏挂钩或重复采集。
多人地图重复点击按真实投票判断，首领记录使用地图节点实际显示内容；保留 v0.107.1 正式版兼容。
受保护版本已通过新版游戏的伤害统计与商店操作检查；保留 v0.107.1 接口兼容。另包含此前开发的可选决策记录及用途告知，不代表真实训练数据验收或模型质量结论。
DamageMeter.changelog_en: Adapt shop and map decision capture to v0.113.0
changelog_detail_en: Resolve the new purchase entry point and shop-list return type without missed hooks or duplicate capture.
Use actual map votes and rendered boss nodes; retain official v0.107.1 compatibility.

The protected build passed v0.113.0 damage-meter and shop smoke tests, with v0.107.1 interface compatibility retained. Includes previously developed optional decision capture and purpose notices; this is not acceptance of real training data or a model-quality claim.

SpeedX.name: 皮皮极速: SpeedX
SpeedX.changelog: 降低伤害预览分配开销，修复超时保护、自动结束预测与设置保存
changelog_detail: 不再缩短等待战斗目标出现的容错超时；正常动作与视觉加速保持可用。
缓存预览颜色、节点路径和不变的显示数据；及时释放临时目标与覆盖层，恢复格挡文字颜色时保留其他覆盖。伤害仍按当前战斗状态计算。
自动结束回合仅在最终决策时进行安全预测，不再在倒计时内逐帧重算；单次预测复用监听对象，先前减伤已归零时不再误耗缓冲。
补齐快捷出牌开关的 ModConfig 持久化，避免不变设置反复触发回调，注册失败时不再误判为可用；悬浮布局按变化刷新，降低回溯统计查询频率。
新增定向回归与故障反例测试；受保护版本已完成本地实机测试并通过新日志校验。
SpeedX.changelog_en: Reduce preview allocations and fix timeout, auto-end safety and settings persistence
changelog_detail_en: Stop accelerating creature-lookup safety timeouts; normal action and visual acceleration remain available.

Cache preview colors, node paths and unchanged presentation data; release temporary targets and overlay nodes at lifecycle boundaries, and restore block text color without discarding other overrides. Damage is still computed from live state.
Run auto-end safety forecasts at the final decision rather than every countdown frame, reuse listeners within each forecast, and preserve Buffer when earlier reductions already eliminate HP loss.

Persist the quick-play toggle through ModConfig, avoid unchanged setting callbacks, and treat failed registration as unavailable. Refresh overlay layout on changes and reduce Rewind statistics polling.
Add focused regression and negative-fixture coverage. The protected build has completed local in-game testing and passed fresh-log verification.

RemoveMultiplayerPlayerLimit.changelog: 适配 v0.99 beta 新 mod 结构
changelog_detail: 新增 v0.99 格式 manifest（外部 JSON + id + affects_gameplay）
多人联机 API 无破坏性变更，Harmony patches 全部兼容

Rewind.name: 皮皮倒带: Rewind
Rewind.changelog: 适配 v0.113.0 回放选牌、地图定位与重开
changelog_detail: 回放选牌改接新版按玩家管理的选择器栈，地图标记及自动定位跟随新版接口。
换种重开适配原生玩家参数和自定义标志，先验证接口再清理旧运行态；保留 v0.107.1 正式版兼容。
受保护版本已通过新版游戏的回合回退、历史回合恢复和节点存档恢复检查；新模式暂不开放换种重开，保留 v0.107.1 接口兼容。
Rewind.changelog_en: Adapt replay selection, map navigation and restart to v0.113.0
changelog_detail_en: Bridge replay selection to per-player selector stacks and adapt map marker/navigation APIs.
Prepare native player/custom-game restart arguments before cleaning the current run; retain v0.107.1.
The protected build passed v0.113.0 turn-reset, earlier-turn and checkpoint-restoration smoke tests. New-mode seeded restarts remain unavailable; v0.107.1 interface compatibility is retained.

ModConfig.name: 皮皮配置: ModConfig
ModConfig.changelog: 重新打包发布 zip，移除 legacy mod_manifest.json 修复游戏菜单里的重复模组条目
changelog_detail: 游戏 v0.99+ 起 <ModId>.json 是唯一的外部 root manifest，但 mod loader 依然会扫描 legacy mod_manifest.json —— 同目录两份 manifest 会被 loader 各自注册为独立模组条目，游戏菜单里就出现同名的红色「已加载」坏条目。
上一版发布 zip 里同时带了两份 manifest。虽然 ModManager.ps1 安装/更新时会调用 Remove-LegacyExternalManifest 清理玩家目录，但 zip 里还带着 mod_manifest.json，紧跟的 Copy-Item 又把它复制回来，等于白清理。
本版重新打包的 zip 只含 <Mod>.json + DLL + PCK，不含 mod_manifest.json。没有代码变更。从上一版更新过来时，ModManager 会删掉玩家目录里残留的 mod_manifest.json，重复条目消失。
ModConfig.changelog_en: repackage release zip without legacy mod_manifest.json to fix duplicate mod entry in game menu
changelog_detail_en: Game v0.99+ introduced <ModId>.json as the sole external root manifest. The mod loader still scans for legacy mod_manifest.json - so when a deployed folder contains both, the loader registers them as two separate mod entries and the game menu shows a duplicate red 'already loaded' row for that mod.

Releases up to and including the previous version shipped both manifests in the zip. Even though ModManager.ps1's install/update path calls Remove-LegacyExternalManifest to clean the target directory, the cleanup was undone because the zip still contained mod_manifest.json and the subsequent Copy-Item step re-deposited it.

This release ships a repackaged zip that contains only <Mod>.json + DLL + PCK. No code changes. Updating from the previous version will trigger ModManager to remove the old mod_manifest.json from the player's game folder and the duplicate entry disappears.

QuickLink.name: 皮皮快连: QuickLink
QuickLink.changelog: 兼容 STS2 测试服 v0.111.0 的联机握手与错误码
changelog_detail: QuickLink 现在会在运行时选择新版或旧版 NetHostGameService 与 NetClientGameService 构造函数，房主直连恢复和客机重连时都会正确携带新版游戏/模组握手信息。
房主可靠信号改为通过兼容层读取 ConnectedPeers 快照，不再绑定任一版本的属性签名。
发生变动的 NetError 改为按运行时名称解析与比较，并补充新的 LobbyJoinTimeout 重连情形。同一 DLL 同时支持正式服 v0.107.1 和测试服 v0.111.0。
QuickLink.changelog_en: Compatibility with the STS2 beta v0.111.0 multiplayer handshake
changelog_detail_en: QuickLink now selects the versioned or legacy NetHostGameService and NetClientGameService constructors at runtime, preserving the new game/mod handshake during direct host restore and client reconnect.
Reliable host signaling now reads ConnectedPeers through a compatibility snapshot instead of binding to either version's property signature.
Moved NetError values are resolved and compared by runtime name, including the new LobbyJoinTimeout reconnect case. The same DLL supports official v0.107.1 and beta v0.111.0.

SkadaHelper.name: 皮皮军师: SkadaHelper
SkadaHelper.changelog: 107和111五职业卡牌与路线参考，补齐低进阶涅奥统计，新增战斗预览
changelog_detail: 支持游戏 v0.107.1 和 v0.111.0，单人五职业各用对应版本的卡牌数据和路线模型；内置卡牌统计共1,484,788局（107为1,042,207局，111为442,581局），不是路线训练样本数。
选牌、升级、删牌和商店可查看评分与统计，地图提供本机计算的参考路线；111战士另有卡组体检、两张牌配合及升级提示。
进阶0–6的卡牌、路线和开局涅奥按进阶7提供参考，不改变实际难度。涅奥选项旁直接显示比例与样本量，缺少对应数据仍显示无统计；其他古人和普通事件范围不变。
111普通事件按事件及选项标识获取统计，区分缺少数据和样本不足；需要联网或已有缓存。
悬停坚毅、痛殴显示预计消耗的牌和从左数的位置，添柴显示预计生成的牌；仅预览当前状态，触发效果或队友行动可能改变结果。
抽牌堆预览默认关闭，可在ModConfig开启；平时只看顶牌，按需展开前5张，提示条可拖动并记住位置。
SkadaHelper.changelog_en: Five-character card and route support for 107/111, low-ascension Neow statistics and combat previews
changelog_detail_en: Supports STS2 v0.107.1 and v0.111.0 with version-specific card data and route models for all five solo characters. Bundled card statistics cover 1,484,788 runs (1,042,207 for 107 and 442,581 for 111), not route-training sample counts.
Card rewards, upgrades, removals and shops show ratings and statistics; the map provides locally computed route references. The 111 Ironclad also has deck checks, card-pair and upgrade hints.

A0-A6 uses A7 references for cards, routes and opening Neow options without changing actual difficulty. Neow shows rates and sample counts directly; missing exact observations remain unavailable. Other ancients and ordinary event ranges are unchanged.
111 ordinary events use event and option identifiers, distinguishing unavailable data from small samples; an internet connection or existing cache is required.

Hovering True Grit or Thrash previews the expected exhausted card and its left-to-right hand position; Stoke previews generated cards. Current-state previews may change after triggers or teammate actions.
Draw-pile preview is off by default and can be enabled in ModConfig. Show one top card normally, expand to five on demand, and drag the panel to a saved position.
